commands:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'PWD='; pwd
printf '
FILES:
'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort | head -200
printf '
TOOLS:
'; for t in python3 python ffmpeg yt-dlp youtube-dl curl wget jq ffprobe; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$t=$(command -v $t)" || echo "$t=missing"; done
